comparison.objective: Adjust a wrench snugly on a nut and loosen it without rounding or loading the movable jaw; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-jaw adjustment, flat engagement, and torque-direction control versus long-rail regrasping, spring-latch insertion, telescoping alignment, screwdriver alignment, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Nut loosened at least 60 degrees without damage and wrench set down versus rail retained at four points with required screws installed.
comparison.reason: Both use hand tools, but one tests safe adjustable-wrench torque while the other tests staged mounting and screw fastening. Candidate torque and damage thresholds are still unspecified.
